description: Deny irrecoverable Bash patterns (rm -rf, find -delete, --no-verify, hooksPath, push --force, reset --hard, clean -f, checkout/restore discards, switch --force, branch -D, stash drop/clear, commit --amend, git add -A/. outside a merge, dd to a device, SQL DROP/TRUNCATE) and a subagent spawning a nested claude -p/--print/--agent/--bg/--worktree session.
Deny (subagent only): git stash (except list/show), reset, clean -- no repo-wide git inside a concurrent wave.
Deny (subagent only): a subagent may not mark its own task completed; only the main session completes tasks.
Ask when an edit to an existing test-shaped path removes an assertion line or adds a skip/disable marker.
Ask before creating a Claude Code settings file, or editing an existing one's hooks / enabledPlugins keys.
